proposals.evidence: DEDR 1298 gives Tamil kal, Malayalam/Kannada kallu, Parji kel, Gadaba kanḍ(u), Gondi kal/kalli and Brahui xal ‘stone’. The matching forms are restricted by the stone sense, preventing confusion with kāl ‘leg’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
